lifecycle: WAIT: root reviews this exact plan and supplies the source/collector freeze path, hash, actual source HEAD and explicit GO. Do not launch from this prepared plan alone.

Preflight: authenticate the root freeze, exact 5 adapter verification files, runtime allowlist/source hashes, unchanged runner, exact public fixture hash inventory, and absent exclusive output identities. Record root delegation and actual command/time before launch. Do not import or fit a learner during preflight.

Launch primary service through the stock runner with a retained PTY tool session. Record returned session ID and owned runner/child PID+PGID, command, cwd, profile and timestamps. Verify live affinity/nice/thread environment from owned process metadata.
Verify readiness by matching the listening 8771 socket to the owned service process using host /proc metadata. Do not make an unlogged HTTP/browser/application probe.

Launch exactly the training collector command once. Record its session and owned process identifiers. Read only status/accounting metadata while it runs; retain full logs and raw evidence without semantic disclosure to root. Poll and communicate at intervals no longer than 60 seconds.

On normal completion, obtain actual collector return code and reap its tool session. Authenticate FINISHED source/command/log records; require both retained run and adapter verification. Check 313 charged decisions, 312 paired Steps, 24 flagged targets, 24 resets, 1 reload, 1 unpaired reset, exact raw hashes and all actual failures against the fixed allocation. Do not infer correctness or inspect task names/answers in the parent handoff.

On collector infrastructure failure, retain partial raw files, records and logs under their original identity. Do not rerun, add calibration or reuse the output identity. Complete cleanup and notify root with filtered accounting/error metadata.

After training terminates, interrupt only the owned service runner via its recorded PTY tool session. Let the unchanged runner terminate and reap its child group; retain the actual expected INTERRUPTED record, child code and wrapper tool exit. Confirm owned runner/child no longer exist and the owned 8771 listener is absent.

Write additive completion/reap and raw-input digest receipts, authenticate the source+collector freeze again, and hand metadata/counts/hashes to root for training preservation. No live service remains. Primary evaluation requires a separately reviewed/frozen predictor+actor+scorer and a separately owned service start.
